t: A confederation of Germanic peoples on the lower Rhine, formed in the 3rd century from older groups such as the Chamavi and Bructeri.
Franks raided Roman Gaul but also served Rome, reaching the highest commands under generals such as Arbogast and Bauto.
Childeric I and his son Clovis I turned the confederation into the Frankish kingdom from which France and Germany grew.
dyk: Childeric I’s grave at Tournai, found in 1653, held some 300 gold bees or cicadas; Napoleon adopted the bee as an imperial emblem partly in their memory.
ev: Frankish raiders break into Roman Gaul; some reportedly reach Spain
Constantine throws the Frankish kings Ascaric and Merogaisus to beasts at Trier
Julian allows the Salian Franks to stay in Toxandria
The Frankish general Arbogast makes Eugenius emperor in the West
King Chlodio takes Cambrai and the land up to the Somme
Franks fight with Aetius at the Battle of the Catalaunian Plains
Childeric I dies at Tournai and Clovis I becomes king

f.capital: No fixed capital; Tournai under Childeric I
f.predecessor: Lower Rhine peoples such as the Chamavi, Bructeri and Chattuarii
